metrics.title: MCP Registry breadth
metrics.description: Registered MCP servers are an observable ecosystem-supply proxy for available integrations and tool surfaces.
metrics.methodology: Counts records returned by the public MCP Registry endpoint. This does not measure active production use.

metrics.title: AI bot traffic index
metrics.description: Track Cloudflare's AI bot HTTP traffic index separately from generic bot traffic, using comparable current and prior 30-day windows.
metrics.methodology: Cloudflare returns MIN0_MAX-normalized values rather than raw request counts. The dashboard shows a 30-day average index and the change versus the prior 30-day control window from the same request. AI bot traffic is not a direct measure of all agent activity.

metrics.title: AI fetcher mix
metrics.description: The share of Fastly AI bot requests classified as fetchers—targeted retrieval tied to a user or agent request—rather than crawlers.
metrics.methodology: Fastly's crawler/fetcher split is a named source classification, not a synthetic action-intensity score. Its fetcher label is a useful but incomplete proxy for agentic workload.

metrics.title: Enterprise AI transactions
metrics.description: Observed enterprise AI/ML transaction and data-transfer signals, with policy and control-plane context.
metrics.methodology: Zscaler is one longitudinal enterprise sample. The initial observation is a calendar-2025 report; revalidate every figure, period, and definition before adding a new point.

metrics.title: Claude artifact yield
metrics.description: Share of sampled Claude Chat and Cowork conversations classified as producing a concrete output artifact.
metrics.methodology: A useful output-production proxy from a named product sample. It is not a measure of autonomy, agent count, enterprise adoption, or total inference volume.

metrics.title: Automation composition
metrics.description: Task mix, automation/augmentation balance, and longer-running task indicators from longitudinal product-usage samples.
metrics.methodology: Treat the Economic Index as a longitudinal product-usage sample, not a census of all AI activity. Preserve qualitative evidence as qualitative when a comparable scalar is unavailable.

metrics.title: Commerce AI-bot share
metrics.description: Akamai's reported share of commerce traffic identified as AI bots, retained as an industry-specific network and security proxy.
metrics.methodology: Akamai reported the share for commerce traffic across its own network as of December 2025. It includes source-defined AI bots, which can include scraping, training, search, or malicious traffic; it is not a measure of beneficial agent tasks, all commerce, or all machine activity.
